releaseNotes: Generalized the welcome-screen prompt library from Appllama's top-welcome-screens (github.com/Appllama/top-welcome-screens) into the skill as motion-craft-benchmarks.md's R11-R14: splash hold-and-cut, staggered multi-asset entrance, honest loader state-switch/skeleton reveal, and paged cold-open with a deterministic final state. Followed the file's existing 60fps.design pattern exactly — numeric, checkable recipes bound to the token scale, never a named app's mascot/wordmark/copy — so the source repo's own NOTICE.md licensing requirement and this file's recipe format agree by construction.

Cross-linked onboarding-conversion.md with a new Cold-Launch / Splash Entrance subsection under Conversion Patterns, pointing to the R11-R14 recipes before the screen-by-screen sequence table starts. Registered github-appllama-top-welcome-screens in source-registry.yaml (inspiration_benchmark) and widened the motion-craft-benchmarks.md and onboarding-conversion.md reference loadWhen triggers plus domain.experience's routeWhen to name welcome/splash screens explicitly, so the capability is discoverable from SKILL.md's Domain Routing table, not just reachable by an agent that already knew to look.

PR review (Codex) caught seven real gaps in R11-R14 before merge, all fixed. R11: Reduce Motion was skipping the real loading gate, not just the authored transition, and hid a stalled load's status from assistive technology entirely -- both now split decorative branding (hidden from the a11y tree) from a real loading state (exposed, noninteractive). R12: the 120-180ms stagger offset had no asset-count cap, so 4+ assets could blow the 600ms durationReveal budget -- now capped at 3 assets at the reference offset with a derivation formula for more; separately, its stated window used seconds (0.3-0.6s) that admitted a 300-359ms band durationSlow's actual 360ms token value forbids -- restated in ms to match the token exactly. R14: Reduce Motion jumped a multi-page cold-open straight to its final state, silently dropping page content the user never chose to skip -- it now replays every page with cuts instead of slides, reserving the final-state jump for an explicit skip-intro control. Workspace template: product/ONBOARDING.md had no Cold Launch row, so onboarding-conversion.md's own instruction to record the R11-R14 recipe there was unfulfillable -- added. Validator: check-motion-contract.ts never parsed R11-R14's own numeric claims, so a future token edit could silently invert R12's window while the gate stayed green -- added a new recipe-window mirror check (motion_contract.recipe_window.value_drift) plus a fail-then-catch fixture that seeds exactly that drift.

Two downstream gates caught by CI after the review-fix commit landed. check:analytics-catalog: the new Cold Launch row names cold_launch_viewed, but analytics/ANALYTICS.md's Event Contract table didn't carry the row yet -- added (fires when a paged cold-open with real page content mounts, per R14). check:generated-pages: product/onboarding.html was stale relative to the edited ONBOARDING.md -- re-rendered via render-artifact-pages.ts --root workspace/business (the default --root resolves to a nonexistent top-level business/ dir, not workspace/business/).
